page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7a.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs using the x86_64 AMD EPYC 7T83 processor running at 2.55 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage options and a baseline network bandwidth of 7 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong single-core CPU capabilities, with stress-ng single-core performance ranking in the top 25%. Multi-core CPU performance, software compilation, and cryptography operations fall within the average range. However, memory performance presents a clear tradeoff: while read-only memory bandwidth is average, large-block write memory bandwidth is weak, placing in the bottom 25% of tested systems. Text generation for small language models is highly efficient, though larger model inference remains average.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource density make this instance a stable choice for workloads requiring consistent compute power without the overhead of GPU or local storage bundles. It is well-suited for general-purpose applications, including static web serving, database operations, redis caching, and moderate text processing tasks.
